name: Normal
description: The baseline every later number in the demo is compared against. Fixed-time signal plan against steady corridor demand.
demand_note: Reuses the base corridor.rou.xml's fixed, constant-probability demand (simulation/networks/corridor.rou.xml) rather than being generated from simulation/scenarios/demand_profiles.py::OFF_PEAK — that profile dict is descriptive reference data, not currently wired into route-file generation. Labeling this scenario 'OFF_PEAK' without that link would be exactly the decorative-label defect already found and fixed once in backend/app/api/simulation.py's scenario_profile field; this note exists so that mistake isn't repeated.
